title: Cross River Bank Launches Its First Bitcoin-Backed Loans With LendingUSA
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Cross River Bank Launches Its First Bitcoin-Backed Loans With LendingUSA Cross River Bank has launched its first bitcoin-backed loans with LendingUSA, offering $10,000 to $250,000 at 30%, 50% or 70% loan-to-value. This post Cross River Bank Launches Its First Bitcoin-Backed Loans With LendingUSA first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
